mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the second mirror was most worthwhile: the explanation of the two reflections made the change in viewing height understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: The lining and folding steps were straightforward but less interesting than learning how the mirrors work.

surprise.text: The hat test showed that the periscope could also follow its movement, not just reveal a stationary object.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the parts had understandable roles, though the construction sequence was predictable.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: the mirror explanation and the working test made this construction feel worth the time, even if several assembly steps were predictable.
